method: Targeted Remotion proof frames, followed by sampled frames extracted from the complete encoded V14 MP4.
checks: Both opening clips fill tall panels with consistent outer margins and center gap.
Facecam is a lower-center overlay at frame zero, not a full-screen obstruction.
Circular 1/2 identities are legible; neither clip's brand or price spoils the blind reveal.
Clip perimeter strokes and face timer remain visible; same real media plays.
Large subscription/per-generation example figures are readable in separate panels.
Monthly units, model-cost estimate qualifier and includes-credits context are visible.
Claude was repositioned during proof review to clear all price-panel explanatory text. Final encoded frame at 14 seconds confirms clearance.
pricingEvidence: Original recorded examples; not proof of current universal prices or matched A/B output costs.
